text:
zoe: Quick thread  prototype for how the console shows 'automatic fallback' provenance. Need to cover: brief inline signal, one-click forensic view, and how billing/quoting is represented. cc @anita @jihoon
jihoon: Core constraints: compact row payload only, full decision stored separately. compact must be searchable and cheap to emit. We need a canonical decision_id and immutable record.
anita: UI idea (compact): small chip: `route=primary` or `route=fallback` with subtle border. Hover opens a tiny panel with: human_reason, latency_diff, cost_hint, and a link "open decision". Use icon + text so color-blind folks ok.
rachel: For telemetry/storage: two-tier events: decision_meta -> logs (compact), decision_blob -> decision-store (full). decision_meta fields: decision_id, trigger, route, cost_hint, sampled_flag. decision_blob contains inputs, routing_graph, model_scores, and operator_notes.
jihoon: Example decision_meta (draft):
```json
{ "decision_id":"d20260318-87","trigger":"latency_p95","trigger_code":"P95>2000ms","route":"redwood-4b-q","cost_hint":"0.0025","sampled":false }
```
tom: Billing/product ask: show both billed_model and attempted_model in the audit. Customers expect to see what they were charged vs what was requested. Prefer billed_on_served by default; product can add a tenant toggle to bill on requested in exceptional workflows.
zoe: Agreed. Compact view should include `billed_on` and a small "why" tooltip.
anita: UX microcopy variants: "Reduced output to meet latency" / "Escalated safety filter applied" / "Rerouted to cheaper variant". Each maps to a different affordance (info, shield, wallet icon).
jihoon: Sampling controls: tenant.sample_rate (0-100%), rollout.override_capture=true during canary. Also support deterministic capture for specific request_ids for debugging.
zoe: Retention defaults? We are proposing meta: 90d, full: 365d archived. Tenants with compliance = true get full 365d without sampling. Need ops to confirm costs.
tom: Retention + search consequences: index decision_meta fields (decision_id, trigger_code, route, billed_on, tenant_id). Also add a boolean fallback_failed if fallback produced an error.
rachel: Operator override model: do NOT update original decision_blob. Create an override_event that references original_decision and records operator_id, timestamp, reason, new_route. This keeps provenance clean. CLI: `rictl decisions show d20260318-87 --with-overrides`
jihoon: Auth: compact view available to app keys; full view requires auditor or operator role. Download link for full blob should be time-limited and logged.
anita: For the console timeline: show a breadcrumb at top of request detail: Request -> Decision chip -> [open audit]. When archived, show "archived" badge and provide link to archive retrieval flow.\oofbot: (bot) Deployed: decision-index-migration by jihoon  endpoints: GET /v1/decisions/{id}?view=meta|full, added sample_rate config for tenants.
zoe: Action items: anita to mock chip + mini panel + icons, jihoon to finalize meta schema + auth rules + sampling knobs, rachel to write storage cost estimate, tom to draft billing toggle language for product. I'll write a short spec and post in the rollout docspace by EOD. Thanks! :rocket:
